interventions.label: H2 CfD (CHPS-style)
interventions.source: CHPS auction and JOGMEC CfD analogue
interventions.modelled_terms: Two-way hydrogen price-gap contract; $3.00/kg strike; 70% of hydrogen volume; modeled coverage 2030–2045
interventions.diligence_terms: reference hydrogen index and settlement formula; minimum/maximum volume and ramp; delivery point and quality; basis and price reopener; parent guarantee or letter of credit; termination compensation
interventions.notes: Residual 30% plus basis sigma 0.05; original volatility returns after tenor

interventions.label: Long-term PPA
interventions.modelled_terms: Fixed-price physical or financial PPA; $65/MWh; 60% of electricity volume; modeled coverage 2028–2043
interventions.diligence_terms: settlement node and hourly shape; balancing and curtailment allocation; renewable-attribute ownership and additionality; inflation and disruption reopener; parent guarantee or letter of credit; termination compensation
interventions.notes: Residual 40% plus basis sigma 0.03; spot exposure returns after tenor

interventions.label: CAPEX subsidy
interventions.source: GX transition bonds and 30% support analogue
interventions.modelled_terms: 30% support for eligible CAPEX; modeled as a construction-date CAPEX reduction
interventions.diligence_terms: eligible-cost definition; milestone disbursement; completion deadline; performance conditions; subsidy cumulation rule; clawback and change-in-control
interventions.notes: CAPEX level reduced 30%; capex volatility retained

interventions.label: Carbon reform commitment
interventions.modelled_terms: Policy support case; reallocates half of status-quo probability to binding carbon-price paths; modeled from 2027
interventions.diligence_terms: legal durability and implementation calendar; covered emissions; free-allocation phaseout; review and reopening rule; change-in-law allocation
interventions.notes: Moves half of status-quo probability to binding scenarios; recomputes level and jump variance

interventions.label: Concessional finance
interventions.modelled_terms: Blended-finance case modeled at 150 bps below firm WACC; debt share and tenor follow the transaction profile
interventions.diligence_terms: facility amount and draw schedule; amortization and maturity; DSCR and reserve covenants; security package; distribution lock-up; prepayment and change-of-control
interventions.notes: Avoid joint use with capex support without a double-counting review

interventions.label: Naphtha/feedstock collar
interventions.source: Long-term feedstock collar screening assumption; replace with an actual index quote
interventions.modelled_terms: Fixed-price or two-way collar; $650/t reference; 70% of feedstock volume; modeled coverage 2028–2043
interventions.diligence_terms: reference grade and pricing index; delivery point and logistics; volume and yield basis; floor/cap settlement; price reopener; credit support; termination and replacement cost
interventions.notes: Residual 30% plus basis sigma 0.06; grade and yield basis need diligence

interventions.label: Circular-feedstock offtake
interventions.source: Long-term circular or bio-feedstock offtake screening assumption; DOE and IEA route anchor
interventions.modelled_terms: Fixed-price or collar offtake; $650/t reference; 65% of circular feedstock volume; modeled coverage 2029–2044
interventions.diligence_terms: eligible feedstock taxonomy and chain of custody; mass-balance accounting; quality and yield specifications; minimum volume and ramp; index and reopener; sustainability attributes; credit support and termination compensation
interventions.notes: Residual 35% plus basis sigma 0.08; taxonomy and mass-balance verification required

interventions.label: Integrated package
interventions.source: Route-applicable input contract plus PPA CAPEX support and carbon reform
interventions.modelled_terms: Route-applicable input contract + PPA + 30% CAPEX support + carbon-policy reform; concessional debt excluded to avoid double counting
interventions.diligence_terms: separate counterparty obligations; matched conditions precedent and long-stop dates; tenor alignment; subsidy and contract cumulation; cross-default limits; no double counting of support
interventions.notes: Concessional debt excluded; engine skips sector or route-inapplicable components

transaction_assumptions.source: CAP illustrative screening profile — replace with lender term sheet and executable quote
transaction_assumptions.notes: Debt rate uses firm WACC; fees zero; 1% annual counterparty PD is a visible stress assumption; not a market quote
